journey.name: spark emergency exit
journey.description:
Verifies the Spark force transfer (the emergency exit) up to the swipe. With a Spark balance, the Spark connection screen shows "Force Transfer To Savings" (testTag "SparkEmergencyExit") under "Transfer To Savings". It opens the "Force Transfer" intro, then the "Transfer overview", which asks the SDK's prepareRecoverFunds for every leaf and lists "Amount to transfer", "Network fees" and "You receive (estimate)" under "Overview". When the transfer needs emergency fees, Continue leads to the "Emergency fees" screen: one row, "Deducted from your Savings balance*" when savings can pay it, otherwise "To be paid with other wallet". Paying from savings leads to "Please confirm" with the swipe; paying with another wallet leads to "Pay to confirm", which shows the address with "Copy address" and starts the transfer once the payment arrives. The journey stops before the swipe: starting a force transfer takes the Spark balance out of Spending for days. The states after the swipe are covered by SparkExitDriverTest, SparkExitRepoTest (a background run from a cold start) and the SparkExitProgressScreen previews.
Precondition: dev build with Spark connected on its regtest (no key needed), a Spark balance, funded at the deposit address the Spark connection screen shows (testTag "SparkDepositAddress") from Lightspark's regtest faucet, and savings that can pay the emergency fees. Start on the wallet home screen.

actions.action: Scroll down and verify "Transfer To Savings" (testTag "SparkTransferToSavings") is enabled and "Force Transfer To Savings" (testTag "SparkEmergencyExit") shows under it
Tap "Force Transfer To Savings" and verify the "Force Transfer" intro says your funds may be unavailable for up to 4 weeks
Tap "Continue" (testTag "SparkExitIntroContinue") and verify the "Transfer overview" screen shows "Getting the costs…" and then "Amount to transfer", "Network fees" and "You receive (estimate)"
Verify no reason shows in red (testTag "SparkExitQuoteBlocked") and "Continue" (testTag "SparkExitQuoteContinue") is enabled
Tap "Continue" and verify the "Emergency fees" screen shows one amount, "Deducted from your Savings balance*" (testTag "SparkExitFeesSavings"), and the note that unused fees return to savings
Tap "Continue" (testTag "SparkExitFundingContinue") and verify "Please confirm" lists the overview and the emergency fees, with a yellow swipe
Go back to the Spark connection screen and verify "Transfer To Savings" is still enabled: nothing started
